name: pmf-superpowers
description: Sequoia Arc PMF framework as auto-triggering, gated skills. Refuses to ship a PMF claim without evidence on record. Built by EnactSkill.

interface.shortDescription: Sequoia Arc PMF framework as gated, refusal-aware skills for founders
interface.longDescription: Use PMF Superpowers to walk through the Sequoia Arc framework — archetype detection (Hair on Fire / Hard Fact / Future Vision) plus the four Terrifying Questions (right to exist, do people care enough, change behavior, pay enough). The plugin refuses to ship PMF claims without evidence on record. Includes a founder-rationalization-defense table (28 entries) and a corpus of iconic-startup cases (Nubank, DoorDash, Dropbox, Square, Robinhood).
defaultPrompt: I'm trying to figure out product-market fit for my startup.
Help me validate whether people care about the problem I'm solving.
